lines.text: At wheat harvest Samson visits his wife with a young goat, but her father refuses and offers her younger sister.
Samson catches three hundred foxes, ties torches to their tails, and releases them into the Philistines' standing grain.
The Philistines burn Samson's wife and her father, so Samson slaughters them and stays in a cave at Sinai.
Three thousand men of Judah bind Samson with two new ropes and bring him to Lehi, where the ropes break.
Samson strikes down a thousand men with a donkey's jawbone, then God opens a hollow place and fire comes out.
